title: IC/04/2011 circular on lein 0f 28th June 2011.
text:
CONF/IRA/00/001/03
28th June, 2011
CIRCULAR NO. IC/04/2011
TO: ALL INSURERS, RE-INSURERS, INSURANCE BROKERS AND MEDICAL
INSURANCE PROVIDERS
RE: CENTRAL BANK FUNDS HELD UNDER LIEN
Reference is made to our circular No. IC/03/2003 dated 17th October 2003 regarding
submission of lien applications to the Insurance Regulatory Authority.
We have noted that insurers continue to submit lien applications late hence not giving
us enough time to scrutinize the documents before approval.
To improve this process, you are hereby advised that all lien applications MUST be
submitted to the Insurance Regulatory Authority at least seven days (7) before due
date.
The applications should be on the usual CDS forms (where applicable) with a
covering letter and a schedule showing the existing liens and their expiry dates.
Please be guided accordingly.
SAMMY M. MAKOVE
COMMISSIONER OF INSURANCE & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
